uutiset.t: IFA 'positive' over stadium upgrades for World Cup
uutiset.s: The Irish Football Association's director of women's football Angela Platt says they are "still working through" plans with the Northern Ireland government to ensure there is funding available to make the necessary upgrades to Windsor Park in time for the 2035 World Cup.

uutiset.t: Raya to miss Dortmund game but injury 'not serious'
uutiset.s: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya will miss Tuesday's Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund but his shoulder injury will not require an operation.

uutiset.t: Wilder to fight Bakole on Fury-Joshua undercard
uutiset.s: Heavyweight Martin Bakole will face former world champion Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury's fight with Anthony Joshua in Cardiff on 11 December.

uutiset.t: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland & Wales to host 2035 Women's World Cup
uutiset.s: The United Kingdom will host a football World Cup for the first time since 1966.

uutiset.t: Rennie gets backing despite All Black defeats
uutiset.s: All Blacks head coach Dave Rennie has received the unequivocal backing of his bosses at New Zealand Rugby.

uutiset.t: Is Marquez MotoGP's greatest of all time?
uutiset.s: After winning his eighth MotoGP world title, BBC Sport assesses the standing of Marc Marquez within the sport.

uutiset.t: England's tearaway quick bowler reinvented as a top-order batter
uutiset.s: Katie George was once a tearaway fast bowler but, after years of injury pain, tells BBC Sport about reinventing herself as a top-order batter.

uutiset.t: 'Right on time' - Kildunne on Quins exit stories
uutiset.s: England and Bristol Bears full-back Ellie Kildunne makes a pointed reference to reports that poor time-keeping was behind her Harlequins exit.

uutiset.t: 'You don't win 345 matches by defending' - Simeone breaks La Liga record
uutiset.s: Diego Simeone records his 345th La Liga victory as Atletico Madrid manager to set a new mark.

uutiset.t: Watford set to appoint former Romania boss Iordanescu
uutiset.s: Watford are set to appoint former Romania coach Edward Iordanescu as their new head coach, reports BBC Three Counties Radio.

uutiset.t: Bellamy an influence as Williams leads Swansea
uutiset.s: Ashley Williams says he has been in regular contact with Wales boss Craig Bellamy since taking temporary charge of Swansea City.

uutiset.t: 'Ridiculous stuff!' - Incredible touchdown throw in NFL best plays
uutiset.s: A "ridiculous" touchdown throw by Tennessee Titans quarterback Cam Ward features in the best plays week 11 of the NFL regular season.

uutiset.t: Morocco and Senegal await Afcon final verdict after court case
uutiset.s: The Court of Arbitration for Sport is set to rule on the decision to strip Senegal of the Afcon 2025 title.

uutiset.t: Andreatta's masterplan to shock Sweden & take Scots to World Cup
uutiset.s: Scotland intend to bring fancied Sweden's World Cup dream "crashing down - and do it in a truly Scottish way", says manager Melissa Andreatta.
